items.question: What is the quickest way to reach you?
items.answer: WhatsApp. Use any WhatsApp button on this site and your message opens pre-filled, ready to send.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Kathmandu or outside Nepal?
items.answer: Yes. Consultations can happen over Zoom or Google Meet, and documents can be shared securely online.

items.question: What should I prepare before a consultation?
items.answer: A short summary of your question, and any relevant documents such as PAN/VAT certificates, previous returns or financial statements.

items.question: Is the information on this website professional advice?
items.answer: No. Articles and tools are general information. For advice on your situation, please book a consultation.
